spec_evidence.checked: Cached vercel OAS snapshots: GET /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/images/{imageId} present through v1.28.8, absent in v1.28.9. v1.28.9 and v1.28.10 define GET /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/images/{imageIdOrDigest} with the same fetch-single-image semantics ('Fetch an individual image from a repository, including its tags and Dockerfile history entries').

alternative_data_source: GET /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/images/{imageIdOrDigest} - widened successor operation accepting an image id or digest.

fix.migration_guide: The single-image fetch operation was re-declared with a widened path parameter that accepts either an image id or a digest. Path parameter names never appear on the wire, and existing image ids remain valid inputs, so raw REST callers keep working unchanged - the mend is confirming the call site and optionally adopting digest lookups. SDK-generated clients are the real breakage surface: the generated method parameter renames from imageId to imageIdOrDigest, so typed call sites must rename the argument.
fix.example_before: const img = await vercel.vcr.getImage({ idOrName: repo, imageId });
fix.example_after: const img = await vercel.vcr.getImage({ idOrName: repo, imageIdOrDigest: imageId }); // ids remain valid; digests now also accepted
